caseNameFull: Halliday v. Squire, Superintendent of Banks
attorneys: Mr. Wm. T. Arnos for petitioner. Mr. Thomas J. Herbert, Attorney General of Ohio, for respondent.

opinions.text:
The motion to proceed on typewritten copies of the record is granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Ohio denied.

Mr. Wm. T. Arnos for petitioner. Mr. Thomas J. Herbert, Attorney General of Ohio, for respondent.
